item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 07/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, it will be windy with improving weather over the coast of southern China during the weekend. The monsoon is expected to moderate gradually early to midweek next week. Temperatures will rise over the region.

Date/Month: 08/04 (Saturday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore later.
Weather: Sunny intervals. Dry during the day.
Temp range: 19 - 23 C
R.H. range: 60 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
